decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has clearly proven its value: it is used by the UK Home Office and connects to over 30 government APIS schemes, so it should be kept as a core offering.
Demand for travel health requirements largely ended after the pandemic, so this option is unlikely to pay off and its resources are better moved to the firm's many other options.
The cyber awareness training module costs little to keep, fits the firm's certified-trainer resources, and its prospects are still uncertain, so the option is worth holding.
The behaviour analysis system builds on the firm's core profiling expertise and its value is still unresolved, so the firm should keep it at low cost.
Passenger security profiling is central to the firm's aviation security methodology and is cheap to keep alongside its established services.
The document verification platform is close to the firm's established offer and has its own web page, and with its prospects still uncertain the option is worth more than its carrying cost.
